description: Draw a book cover. Answers with links to the image (SVG and PNG) and to edit it in the app, and the style, palette and seed it used.

badge.description: A seal in a corner, such as "Winner of the Hugo Award".

case.description: The title in capitals, or as typed.

colors.description: Your own colours instead of a palette, as hex.

credit.description: A credit under the subtitle, such as "Translated by Ann Lee".

font.description: The title's font instead of the style's: serif, didone, garamond, sans, geometric, humanist, condensed, display, mono.

format.description: paperback, ebook, square, or a size in px such as 1600x2560 (Kindle). Default: paperback (2:3).

genre.description: With no style, pick one that suits a genre: literary (Literary), thriller (Thriller & crime), horror (Horror), romance (Romance), fantasy (Fantasy & sci-fi), children (Children’s), nonfiction (Non-fiction).

lang.description: The text's language, a tag such as tr or zh-Hant, for its capitals (Turkish İ) and letterforms. Default: from the text.

output.description: An absolute path of an .svg file to save the SVG to (a new file, or an SVG it replaces).

palette.description: A palette, by id or name (see list_palettes), or "auto" (the default: the seed picks one).

seed.description: Every random choice comes from it: the same seed draws the same cover; another, a variation.

series.description: A series line above the title, such as "Book Two of the Ember Cycle".

style.description: A style, by id or name (see list_styles), or "random" (the default: the seed picks one).

svg.description: Also answer with the SVG markup (large).

title.description: The book's title. A line break (\n) breaks its line on the cover.

variants.description: Choices a style lets you pin, as list_styles shows them, such as { "scene": "forest" }.

name: create_cover
title: Create a book cover
